claims.text: A floating-point expansion of the one-loop gamma* -> 3 gamma amplitude gives six low-energy density terms to s^9, with c1/c0 numerically agreeing with 335/714. The two-loop Euler-Heisenberg coefficients multiply the leading coefficient by 1 + (1555/153) alpha/pi, its full O(alpha^5) term. With cutoff s=4m^2, that factor and the O(alpha^2) pair channel, the model has r_Gamma=20.64/m and r_x=22.55/m. These are CHECKED model roots. An analytic envelope evaluated in float64 bounds the spectral truncation for s <= 1.5 m^2; with the model assumed right within a factor 2 above that, the truncation moves the radii by less than 3e-4/m. Higher perturbative orders are not bounded.

Off-shell structures are checked by the Ward identity and the EH limit only; on-shell ones also by DKR to omega^6 and by Abdul Hameed-Chaubey-Shao 2026 to omega^14.

The truncation envelope covers s <= 1.5 m^2 only and is evaluated in float64, not interval-certified; above 1.5 m^2 the six-term model is assumed right within a factor 2 (0.04% of Phi_3gamma at r_Gamma).
